scope: All encoded text literals physically defined in the five assigned C files, including unused, empty and control-only fallback strings; excludes included headers, resource paths and comments. All 1226 string-bearing source lines were read before filtering. Counts are C text literals, not assembly dialogue blocks.
review_type: Complete source-string reading with targeted consumer/config inspection; no runtime or rendered UI review.
